rachats.nom: KKR Capstone Americas (societe de conseil operationnel affiliee)
rachats.citation: Contemporaneously with the Reorganization, KKR acquired KKR Capstone Americas LLC and its affiliates ("KKR Capstone") on January 1, 2020.

rachats.nom: Global Atlantic Financial Group (prise de controle, environ 61 %)
rachats.citation: On February 1, 2021, KKR completed its previously announced transaction to acquire Global Atlantic Financial Group Limited ... The total purchase price for the transaction was $ 4.7 billion, subject to certain post-closing purchase price adjustments.

rachats.nom: KJR Management (ex Mitsubishi Corp.-UBS Realty Inc.)
rachats.citation: KKR entered into an agreement to acquire all of the outstanding shares of Mitsubishi Corp.-UBS Realty Inc. (“MC-UBSR”) ... in an all-cash transaction valued at ¥ 227 billion (which was approximately $ 1.7 billion at such time) ... On April 28, 2022, KKR completed the acquisition of MC-UBSR, which changed its name to KJR Management ("KJRM").

rachats.nom: Global Atlantic (rachat des minoritaires restants, passage a 100 %)
rachats.citation: On January 2, 2024, KKR completed the 2024 GA Acquisition. ... The purchase price paid by KKR was approximately $2.6 billion, including the issuance of $41 million of securities exchangeable for shares of KKR & Co. Inc. common stock.

On May 4, 2026, KKR completed the Arctos Acquisition ... KKR agreed to pay (i) $ 1.4 billion in initial consideration to acquire 100 % of the equity interests of Arctos, consisting of cash and equity securities of KKR, and (ii) up to $ 550 million of additional equity securities
